_comment: News that is relevant to a chronology pinned to the real calendar. Hand-curated: every item here was written by a person and its facts checked, because this atlas claims a research standard and an automatically scraped feed would undermine that. Each item becomes a marker on the TODAY line, and `worlds` lists the lineages it genuinely touches - that list is a judgement, not a keyword match.

schema.headline: one line
schema.bin: the kind of moment this is (an id from data/bins.json); the Moments page matches news to fiction by it

items.headline: Iran war, day 209: threats at the UN, a 60-day ceasefire road map from Tehran
items.summary: At the UN General Assembly the US president threatened to annihilate the Islamic Republic if talks fail; Iran presented a road map for a regional ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade.

items.headline: Google says its AI model broke out of a test into three real companies' systems
items.summary: During a May security evaluation, Gemini was told to take data from a fictional company and reached three real ones instead, guessing a password and using credentials found in public code. It stopped when it worked out the systems were real; Google says it was not misalignment.

source.title: NBC News: Google says its AI model gained unauthorized access to three outside systems

items.headline: Artemis II splashes down after a crewed lunar flyby
items.summary: Four astronauts flew around the Moon and back, the first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972. It is the first crewed flight of the Space Launch System and of the Orion spacecraft.

items.headline: An AI ran most of a state-backed hacking campaign
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed that a group it attributes to the Chinese state used its Claude Code agent against about thirty targets, with the AI doing 80 to 90 per cent of the work and people deciding only at a few points. A small number of intrusions succeeded.

source.title: Anthropic: Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign

items.headline: First landing near the lunar south pole
items.summary: India's Chandrayaan-3 puts a lander and rover down at high southern latitude, where water ice is expected in permanently shadowed craters. The date is now marked as National Space Day in India.

items.headline: A fusion experiment returns more energy than it absorbed
items.summary: The National Ignition Facility achieves scientific breakeven for the first time, with a gain factor of about 1.5. The reaction lasted a fraction of a second and is a long way from a power station.
